title: Width of the Refundable Fee Pool on Card-Active Savings Relationships
content:
The refundable fee pool of a savings or money market account of Savings & Money Market Accounts widens with the owner's card relationship. Two facts are read from the owner's card under Personal Credit Cards: the count of card purchases posted in the twelve calendar months ending on the review date, and the unredeemed rewards points the card carries.

| Card purchases in the twelve calendar months ending on the review date | Unredeemed rewards points | The refundable fee pool |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 5 or more | at least 10000 | every monthly maintenance fee and every paper statement fee posted to the account in those twelve calendar months |
| 3 or 4 | at least 10000 | the monthly maintenance fees posted to the account in the three calendar months ending on the review date |
| fewer than 3 | any | the monthly maintenance fee posted to the account in the one calendar month ending on the review date |
| any | fewer than 10000 | the monthly maintenance fee posted to the account in the one calendar month ending on the review date |

### What widens and what does not

Only the widest band takes in paper statement fees; the other two bands take monthly maintenance fees alone. The rewards condition of 10000 unredeemed points governs both widened bands, so a card with 9999 points leaves the pool at the one calendar month's monthly maintenance fee however many purchases posted.

### A worked case on hypothetical inputs

Take a savings account carrying monthly maintenance fees of 5.00 USD in each of the last three calendar months and paper statement fees of 2.00 USD in each of twelve, with 12 monthly maintenance fees of 5.00 USD posted across those twelve calendar months.

With 6 card purchases in the window and 15000 unredeemed points, the pool is the 60.00 USD of monthly maintenance fees together with the 24.00 USD of paper statement fees, that is 84.00 USD. With 4 purchases and the same points, the pool is the 15.00 USD of monthly maintenance fees of the last three calendar months. With 2 purchases, or with 8000 points, the pool is the 5.00 USD posted in the one calendar month ending on the review date.

### Boundary of the counts

A count of exactly 5 card purchases falls in the widest band, a count of exactly 3 in the middle band, and a count of 2, 1 or 0 in the narrowest. Exactly 10000 unredeemed rewards points satisfies the points condition.
